No thinkingConfig or maxOutputTokens/thinking interaction is verified: Gemini 2.5 models think by default, thoughtsTokenCount is billed into output_tokens, and S7/S8 must confirm the budget and price it with a live call.
No safetySettings are sent, so Vertex default thresholds apply to every Gemini call; the owner must accept or set thresholds before S8.

The endpoint shape, the eu multi-region path segment (Google's page confirms only the host aiplatform.eu.rep.googleapis.com), the token exchange, the generateContent body and the SSE framing are unverified against Google; the S8 owner-funded run must prove them.
The gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash pages announce retirement on 2026-10-20, already past on 2026-11-03, so S8 must choose currently served model ids and source their rows before enablement.
Google's locations page leaves the per-region Gemini support cells blank, so S8 must confirm availability in each allowlisted europe-* region before any location is enabled.

A non-EU VERTEX_GEMINI_LOCATION refuses registration, while D12 says such a location classifies Global; the Global branch of vertex_residency is reachable only from tests, so reconcile with D12 at S8.
On 401 or 403 from generateContent the cached Vertex token is kept until its expiry; dropping it on those statuses stops a revoked key from failing for up to an hour.

Not tested: the 429 retry-after path, a mid-stream safety block (content_filter), a multi-byte character split across network chunks (the decoder buffers bytes to the newline), and a stream that errors mid-body.

With the switch off, an OpenAI-shaped deployment whose id starts with gemini no longer routes there; every other id keeps its route and no such Azure deployment is known, so confirm before enablement.
is_deployed checks the OpenAI deployed catalog for non-Claude ids, so a Gemini rung in a tool_fallback_ladder is skipped whenever Azure OpenAI is configured; decide when ladders carry Gemini.

The chain never gates on supports_tools (pre-existing), so a tool request reaches a provider that silently ignores tools; the Gemini adapter refuses them, but that guard depends on the chain's ordering.
Thought signatures are ignored per D5; reopen with S7 when tool-call replay is built, since a multi-round Gemini tool turn might need them.
Credentials-file permissions are not checked at registration; the S8 secret mount should be read-only and owner-only.
Switch-off regression on the Anthropic-only stack (provider absent from /v1/models, boot clean) is a live proof for the lead; the unit fallback tests cover registration only.
classify_failure and refuses_request duplicate the private helpers in anthropic.rs; hoist them to one shared place in a cleanup slice.
FallbackChain::from_config reads the VERTEX_GEMINI_* environment on every build; that is boot-only today, but a per-request rebuild would re-read the key file.

A unary safety block becomes RequestRejected (gemini.rs parse_response), so the chain may let another provider answer a prompt Gemini refused, while a stream safety block ends as stop_reason content_filter. One policy must be chosen and both paths aligned before enablement.

No safetySettings and no thinkingConfig are sent. Vertex default thresholds apply, and Gemini 2.5 thinks by default, with thoughtsTokenCount billed into output_tokens. Both need owner sign-off and live pricing before S8.

The model_record rows for gemini-2.5-pro and gemini-2.5-flash carry an announced retirement date of 2026-10-20, which has already passed. S8 must source rows for model ids Google still serves before enablement.
A non-EU VERTEX_GEMINI_LOCATION refuses registration, while D12 says it should classify as Global. vertex_residency's Global branch is reachable only from tests; reconcile with D12 at S8.

Behaviour changes with the switch off: provider_serves_model now excludes any gemini* id from the OpenAiCompatible family, so an Azure/OpenAI-shaped deployment named gemini* would stop routing even with VERTEX_GEMINI_ENABLED unset. No such deployment is known.

VertexTokenProvider keeps a cached token after a 401/403 from generateContent until it expires. A revoked key can therefore fail calls for up to an hour; the cache should be invalidated on those statuses.
FallbackChain::is_deployed checks the OpenAI deployed catalogue for any non-Claude id, so a Gemini rung in a tool_fallback_ladder is pruned whenever Azure OpenAI declares a catalogue.

No tests cover: the 429 Retry-After path (only integer seconds are parsed, otherwise 1s), a mid-stream safety block that yields content_filter, a UTF-8 character split across network chunks, or a body error mid-stream.
The credentials file's permissions are not checked, and the key file's token_uri is trusted as the exchange endpoint. The S8 secret mount must be read-only and owner-only.
classify_failure and refuses_request in gemini.rs duplicate the private helpers in anthropic.rs; hoist them into one shared place.
FallbackChain::from_config re-reads the VERTEX_GEMINI_* environment and the key file on every build. That is fine while it runs at boot only, but a rebuild per request would re-read the secret.

The gateway replay suite has never run. Cassette 01 expects no tools offered and exactly one streamed ANSWER call, so if a plain /v1/invoke/stream offers default tools or makes an auxiliary infer call first, the replay will refuse it and either the cassette or the harness must change.

It drives POST /v1/invoke/stream through build_router, with the InferenceCore channel from mp_inference_replay::serve over cassette 01 (plain answer, no tools). It asserts the SSE event sequence ends with done, the streamed text is PONG, replay.finish() is Ok, and the run's terminal receipt is Completed (gateway-direct, scoped workload token, heartbeats) via assert_direct_terminal_for_prepared_run. Dev auth uses MODEL_GATEWAY_AUTH_DEV_BYPASS as e2e does. The session-core, managed-run and JWT doubles are verbatim blocks copied by a generator script from e2e_invoke_chain_test.rs (read only): imports 1-100; aliases 1124-1128; doubles 1130-2005; JWT helpers 2677-2760; delegated tokens 2797-2881 and 2913-2922; session spawn and mock_turns 2978-3028; MockMessageTree 3032-3063; make_state and assertion helpers 3247-3383; sse_frames 4301-4319. The RSA test key is generated at run time, so no key text was copied. Checks: no file-level use lines in e2e after line 100 were missed, and a textual check of free-function calls found nothing obviously undefined. The compiler is the real check.
